newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates edge up to 21 pct in busy mkt.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates edge up to 21 pct in busy mkt.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed a shade higher on Wednesday as most banks chose to err on the side of caution filling up their reserves towards the end of the two-week reserve period.
"Most banks took up money, with two major players on the supply side," said Sandor Tolonics of Commerzbank.
Overnight rates traded between 20.875 percent and 21.125 percent and closed at 21 percent, compared to Tuesday's close of 20.875/21.00 percent.
